title: Offline scripted demonstration — no PC code is modified

decision.title: Choose authentication approach
decision.summary: Use OAuth rather than storing passwords?
decision.rationale: A managed identity flow avoids building and maintaining password storage for this prototype.

question_answer.question: Why not store passwords?
question_answer.answer: Password storage requires additional security controls. OAuth is a reasonable first-prototype choice, but depends on an external identity provider.

reject.result: Simulated alternative proposed; no OAuth changes made
